t: This is Hyde Park Corner Lodge, a small architectural structure in Westminster. It was designed by Decimus Burton, one of the foremost English architects and landscapers of the nineteenth century. He was the leading Victorian architect in the Roman Revival, Greek Revival and Georgian neoclassical styles, and a founding fellow and vice-president of the Royal Institute of British Architects. His father, James Burton, was the pre-eminent Georgian London property developer. The lodge is a modest example of the classical tradition he worked in.
